description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notice published in Gazette Ex. No. 2054/41 - Business hours of the liquor licensed, was passed on 07.06.2018
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of business hours for liquor licensed establishments through an Excise Notification. It involves regulatory changes to the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52) and specifies operational requirements for commercial establishments, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories. The content focuses on regulatory compliance requirements for specific business types.
